book.name: 2 TESALONIKA
book.title: 2 TESALONIKA Tesalonika mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge arnu kuyarna

content: Yabaŋam tuku pasa
O tira kame, ye pasa te ndo satiŋgamŋgit. Suŋgo tuku pasa tane ŋgamukŋge suŋgokina taŋamba afu ŋgamukŋge suŋgokuwa ŋga tane sine tuku ŋga Kuate yabaŋap.
Kuate tuku pasa isig mbal afu son nda ŋgade. Ta tuku taŋgo ŋaigonu nane sine ŋaigo siglikubekaig ŋga Kuateŋge sine tursiŋgam tuku ŋga yabaŋap.
Suŋgo nuŋge tane tuku ŋgamuŋgal saŋgri piletiŋgamŋgat. Nu tane kulatkuwa le Satan nu tane ŋaigo siglike nda.
Suŋgo nu wamdus siŋgina le sine tane tuku wamdus ar ar ndaweg. Sine wam pagu pasa buk satiŋgigeŋ ta tane taŋamba ndo ke lika minmba minamŋgaig ta sine kila.

Kuateŋge tane wamdus purfeu sertiŋguwa le nu tane tuku suŋgomba kume purte wam Yesus nu saŋgri tiŋga bike ndakina maŋau ta lato lato kila patika wamdus saŋgri tiŋgap ŋga ye tane tuku ŋga Kuate yabaŋet.
Pirokam tuku pasa

Tira kame, sine siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus tuku nyu mbolŋge wam pagu pasa te satiŋgamŋgig. Tira ande nu sine tane wam pagu tiŋgigeŋ pasa ta pitaimba piro ndaka ake kaloimba minwa kande tane nu ndoŋ ulendi ndakap.
Sine tane ŋgamukŋge mingeŋ ta ake kaloimba mine ndakigeŋ.
Sine afu tugumŋge nyamagaŋ ake yai ndakigeŋ. Sine ŋakmba piyamba kilgeŋ. Sine tane piti tiŋbekig ŋga ki furir mindek siŋgine waimbi piroka matuk kageŋ.
Sine Kristus tuku piro mbal tukunu sine tane tuku agaŋ ndende ake kilam kumuŋ ta tane sine tuku maŋau ta kubemba taŋamba pirokap ŋga sine piroka tane tuku agaŋ ndende kile ndakigeŋ.
Sine tane ŋgamukŋge mingeŋ sulumba teŋenmba wam pagutiŋgigeŋ. Taŋgo ima nu piro ndaka ake minwa kande nu nyamagaŋ nye ndakuwa ŋgigeŋ.
Tane tuku afu kanyummba ake kaloimba minig sulumba afu tuku wam kugerkade ta afuŋge kubede le sine iseg.
Sine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus tuku nyu mbolŋge mbal taŋaŋ wam pagu pasa tembi sarsarniŋgamŋgig. Nane wamdus bafukmbi piroka piro tuku piya tambi naŋgine nyamagaŋ piyawaig.
Tira kame, tane wam magenu kam tuku kanyum ndawap.
Sine waŋe te pilbe le tane tugum prowa le ande nu sine tuku pasa te pitaiwa kande tane nu kaŋgermba kiko tuwa ŋga nu ndoŋ ulendi ndakap.
Nu tane tuku tira ta nu ŋgueu taŋgo taŋaŋ kaŋger ndamba nu riroŋ pasa tape.
Kaiye pasa
Ŋgamuŋgal mukuk wamdus bulok maŋau Suŋgo nu tugu. Nuŋge mara mara taŋgine mine ŋakmba tuku ŋgamuŋgal mukuk wam bul sertiŋguwa. Nu tane ŋakmba ndoŋ minwa. Son.
Ye Paulus ye kile yiŋe waimbi kaiye pasa te kuyaramŋgit. Tane ŋakmba kaiye. Waŋe te ye tuku ŋga tane katesewam tuku ye yiŋe wai kuyar tuku maŋau pilet. Yiŋe waŋe ŋakmba mbolŋge ye taŋawet.
Siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus nu tane ŋakmba ake sinaŋ make patikuwa. Son.
